args.Instruction: Rewrite magicAutoBuild html dropdown and js logic to support all patterns
args.ReplacementContent:
<select id="magicPattern" style="width:100%; padding:10px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--glass-border); background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-main); outline:none;">
                       <option value="28/28">B2B (28 Work / 28 Leave)</option>
                       <option value="28/14">2/1 (28 Work / 14 Leave)</option>
                       <option value="14/14">14 Work / 14 Leave</option>
                       <option value="5/2">Office Pattern (5/2)</option>
                       <option value="365/0">Continuous (365 Work)</option>
                   </select>`,
            background: 'var(--card-bg)',
            color: 'var(--text-main)',
            showCancelButton: true,
            confirmButtonText: '✨ Generate Now',
            confirmButtonColor: '#8b5cf6',
            preConfirm: () => {
                return {
                    start: document.getElementById('magicStartDate').value,
                    pattern: document.getElementById('magicPattern').value
                }
            }
        }).then((res) => {
            if(res.isConfirmed && res.value.start) {
                let currentStart = parseDate(res.value.start);
                let patternVal = res.value.pattern;
                
                let workDays = 28;
                let leaveDays = 28;
                let isContinuous = false;
                
                if (patternVal === "28/14") { workDays = 28; leaveDays = 14; }
                else if (patternVal === "14/14") { workDays = 14; leaveDays = 14; }
                else if (patternVal === "5/2") { workDays = 5; leaveDays = 2; }
                else if (patternVal === "365/0") { workDays = 365; leaveDays = 0; isContinuous = true; }

                // Generate approximately 1 year of rotations
                let targetDate = new Date(currentStart);
                targetDate.setFullYear(targetDate.getFullYear() + 1);

                while (currentStart < targetDate) {
                    // 1. Add Work period
                    let endD = new Date(currentStart);
                    endD.setDate(endD.getDate() + workDays - 1);
                    
                    records.push({
                        id: 'magic_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2,5),
                        type: 'work',
                        start: formatDateRaw(currentStart),
                        end: formatDateRaw(endD)
                    });
                    
                    if (!isContinuous) {
                        // 2. Add Leave period
                        let leaveStart = new Date(endD);
                        leaveStart.setDate(leaveStart.getDate() + 1);
                        let leaveEnd = new Date(leaveStart);
                        leaveEnd.setDate(leaveEnd.getDate() + leaveDays - 1);
                        
                        records.push({
                            id: 'magic_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2,5),
                            type: 'leave',
                            start: formatDateRaw(leaveStart),
                            end: formatDateRaw(leaveEnd)
                        });
                        
                        // Set currentStart for next iteration
                        currentStart = new Date(leaveEnd);
                        currentStart.setDate(currentStart.getDate() + 1);
                    } else {
                        // If continuous, next block is also work, directly after
                        currentStart = new Date(endD);
                        currentStart.setDate(currentStart.getDate() + 1);
                    }
                }

    // ---------------------------------
    // SMART SYSTEM CLOCK
    // ---------------------------------
    function updateSystemClock() {
        const now = new Date();
        let h = now.getHours();
        let m = now.getMinutes();
        let s = now.getSeconds();
        const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
        
        h = h % 12;
        h = h ? h : 12;
        
        document.getElementById('sysHour').innerText = h < 10 ? '0' + h : h;
        document.getElementById('sysMin').innerText = m < 10 ? '0' + m : m;
        document.getElementById('sysSec').innerText = s < 10 ? '0' + s : s;
        document.getElementById('sysAmPm').innerText = ampm;
        
        const options = { weekday: 'short', year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: '2-digit' };
        document.getElementById('sysDate').innerText = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', options).toUpperCase();
    }
    setInterval(updateSystemClock, 1000);
    updateSystemClock(); // run immediately
    </script>
</body>
</html>
